basic_profile.bio: An avid fan of strategic games and passionate about handcrafted woodworking, I reside in the scenic Pacific Northwest. My days are mostly spent in my workshop, crafting unique chess boards and other wooden art pieces. I've been married for 8 years and have two energetic kids. I enjoy spending my evenings playing strategy games and watching chess tournaments online. My dislike for mass-produced, low-quality goods drives my commitment to quality craftsmanship. Typically online during late evenings, I balance my time between family, work, and my online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design and a lifelong interest in woodworking, I have taught myself the intricacies of creating handmade chess boards through online courses and extensive practice. My fascination with strategy games, fueled by years spent playing games like chess and real-time strategy titles, complements my crafting skills.
